messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
messages.subject: PyStan 2.8.0.2 released
parts:
PyStan 2.8.0.2 is available on PyPI. This releases contains a variety of
minor improvements. The Stan library used remains the same (2.8.0).

Highlights:

- Compiler optimization is turned on for model compilation.
- Specifying a subset of parameters (via the `pars` keyword) in sampling
now works as expected.
- Python 3.5 support.

One important note about this release: PyStan 2.8.0.2 requires Cython
0.22 or higher (previously 0.19 or higher had been required). Cython's
support for interfacing with C++ code has improved tremendously in the
past year. Many bugs have been fixed. Requiring Cython 0.22 means that
there need to be fewer bug workarounds in PyStan. Newer versions of
Python (3.5+) already require a higher version of Cython.

Download the latest version at

https://pypi.python.org/pypi/pystan
